title: AgentFold: Long-Horizon Web Agents with Proactive Context Folding
abstract: LLM-based web agents show immense promise for information seeking, yet their effectiveness on long-horizon tasks is hindered by a fundamental trade-off in context management. Prevailing ReAct-based agents suffer from context saturation as they accumulate noisy, raw histories, while methods that fixedly summarize the full history at each step risk the irreversible loss of critical details. Addressing these, we introduce AgentFold, a novel agent paradigm inspired by the human cognitive process of retrospective consolidation. AgentFold treats its context as a dynamic cognitive workspace to be actively sculpted, rather than a passive log to be filled. At each step, it learns to execute a folding operation, which manages its historical trajectory at multiple scales: it can perform granular condensations to preserve vital, fine-grained details, or deep consolidations to abstract away entire multi-step sub-tasks. The results on prominent benchmarks are striking: our AgentFold-30B-A3B agent achieves 36.2% on BrowseComp and 47.3% on BrowseComp-ZH. Notably, this performance not only surpasses or matches open-source models of a dramatically larger scale, such as the GLM-4.5-355B-A32B and the DeepSeek-V3.1-671B-A37B, but also surpasses leading proprietary agents like OpenAI's o4-mini. Model will be open-sourced.
problem: LLM-based web agents on long-horizon tasks face a fundamental tradeoff between context saturation from noisy histories and irreversible loss of critical details from fixed summarization.
approach: AgentFold treats context as a dynamic cognitive workspace inspired by retrospective consolidation, learning to execute folding operations at multiple scales with granular condensations or deep consolidations while managing historical trajectories.
contribution: AgentFold-30B-A3B achieves 36.2% on BrowseComp and 47.3% on BrowseComp-ZH, surpassing or matching open-source models of dramatically larger scale and proprietary agents like OpenAI's o4-mini.
